name: Mercenary Planned Attack
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Planned Attack (players/gladiator/mercenary/planned_attack_merc.sval, 14 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): same numbers; works with any class's primary attack. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Builds up to 7 guaranteed crits (one per second) for any primary attack, not just Trident stacks.
